rule_or_requirement: Pixel-only learned gas authority must generalize beyond TRAIN and preserve valid completion before speed can decide.
observable_information: Rendered pixels and inherited pixel-driver action at inference; matched TUNE completion, lap, collision and latency telemetry for evaluation.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Veto boost when inherited gas is below 0.08, otherwise increase gas by at most 0.04 capped at 0.28; retain coast and inherited steering/braking.
expected_success_endpoint: At least selected valid completion, zero invalid actions, 100 bounded boosts, 20 vetoes and, on completion tie, at least 2% median finished-lap improvement overall and jointly finished.
control: Unchanged selected stable-risk pixel driver on the same twelve previously unused TUNE cells.
falsifier: Lower valid completion, invalid action, inactive mechanism or insufficient lap improvement on a completion tie.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two frozen pixel-only arms on tracks 1-3 x fresh TUNE seeds 5224-5227, 24 episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
